claim.summary: Pair conditioning ceiling: over F_2, an unsatisfiable system on N pairs (u_i, v_i) with Boolean axioms, pair axioms u_i v_i and further axioms of degree <= d each in the variables of at most w pairs has 1 in C_D for D = max(d, w + 1, tau), tau the elimination depth (treedepth) of the pair graph joining two pairs that share an axiom: the states of a pair have affine indicators 1 + u + v, u, v summing to 1, so branching on a pair costs one degree, and the restricted axioms split over the components of what is left. For every set I, tau <= N - |I| + tau(G[I]); an induced forest by a random order has >= 2N/(Delta+1) pairs (Delta >= 1 the maximum degree, <= r(w-1) when a pair is in at most r axioms) and depth <= floor(log2 N) + 1. So the ceiling is below 0.77N (the pair threshold of lem:group-relaxation-level-count) whenever Delta <= 7 and N is large. Generalizes the conditioning step of thm:compact-colouring-degree-ceiling (independent set, depth one: max(4, s+1)).
